_comment: Question-bank scraper sources. Enable a source by setting "enabled": true. The workflow runs daily 03:00 UTC and the script enforces the admin-configured schedule (edit .github/workflows/scrape-weekly.yml for frequency). Everything scraped lands as DRAFT in the Admin → Question bank → review & publish. Types: "json" (array or {questions|items|data: [...]}), "html", "markdown" (marker-based: `N. ### Q` + answer body, `#### Topic` + question sentence, or line-based `?` fallback), "company-list" (company/pattern-grouped problem titles — facts only, never statements), "hackernews" (official Algolia API `{hits:[...]}`, keyless). Legal posture: raw.githubusercontent.com + official public APIs only; titles/topics kept, answers are AI-original (see docs/question-bank-expansion.md).
